name: Surfline MCP Server
description: Enables access to comprehensive surf forecasts from Surfline including current conditions, swell analysis, forecaster insights, tides, and timing information for Santa Cruz surf spots. Provides detailed 8-hour forecasts with expert observations through secure Google OAuth authentication.
